about.intro: Hey! I'm Namanh, 20 years old and studying Computer Science at Hamburg University of Technology. On the side, I work as a working student in AI automation and build a startup for students as CTO.

about.hobbies: Outside of work, I'm either doing calisthenics, playing in my band, or creating tech content on TikTok (50k+ followers).

proj-1.title: Dip – Give LLMs Eyes
proj-1.description: 1st Place, Google DeepMind Gemini Track – Cursor AI Hackathon Hamburg (Feb 2026, 400+ participants). A tool that gives LLMs real-time visual context of the user's screen, eliminating the need to manually describe on-screen content.

proj-2.title: Mindflayer – Semantic Social Media Filter
proj-2.description: 1st Place Overall ($2,000 prize) – CodeRabbit × Windsurf Hackathon (Dec 2025, 110 participants). A Chrome extension using Gemini to semantically filter social media posts in real-time.

proj-3.title: Airbn – AI Property Management
proj-3.description: 1st Place Arbio Track, 3rd Overall – {Tech: Europe} Hackathon Berlin (Jan 2026). An AI-native property management platform with microservices architecture, voice-first guest support, and automated damage detection via OpenCV.

proj-4.title: Hundewelt.space – AI Dog Blog
proj-4.description: Fully automated German dog blog with AI content pipeline. Next.js frontend with SSR, search, RSS, and admin dashboard. Python LangGraph pipeline for topic research, article generation, image generation, and automatic publishing.

proj-5.title: Video Journal Analyzer
proj-5.description: A web app for analyzing video URLs with two modes: diary entry analysis (emotions and moods) and rhetoric coach (speaking style, articulation, improvement suggestions).

proj-6.title: Song Splitter
proj-6.description: An audio tool for splitting songs into individual components such as drums, guitar, bass, vocals, and other instruments using AI-powered audio source separation.
